parts.text:
The passage outlines the roles of blood vessels associated with the heart.
Complete the passage by using the most appropriate scientific terms.
The ........................................ carries blood to the left atrium. After passing from the left atrium to the left ventricle, blood is pumped into the aorta. The aorta is one of two large arteries that carry blood away from the ventricles of the heart. Blood that leaves the heart to enter these arteries must pass through the ........................................ valves.
Oxygenated blood is supplied to the cardiac muscle cells through the ........................................ arteries.
